runtime.name: codex-cli
runtime.configuration: Generated Skills and role TOML in a disposable Git fixture with isolated CODEX_HOME; role contracts supplied inline because custom-role selection was unavailable.
runtime.permissionProfile: workspace-write sandbox with read-only delegated contracts and automatic approval review

assertions.evidence: Generated repository Skills and roles were the only workflow resources used.
All four literal files and hashes were frozen before delegation.
Both reviewer start operations preceded the first explicit wait.
The root reports identical complete initial packets; both child results cover the full frozen scope without later messages.
Both complete reviews were frozen without repair, retry, or replacement.
Both inline contracts were read-only and Git stayed clean.
One synthesizer started after both reviewer completions.
Both reviewer results remained attributable through synthesis.
F1 was retained as reachable Act on.
The root reread, rehashed, independently traced, ran the verifier, and checked clean Git.
The final report said no fallback was used even though generated role contracts were supplied inline because this CLI has no native custom-role selector.

limitations: This run motivated an explicit fixture definition that inline role-contract delivery is a fallback and must be reported as used.
